answer: To resist sybils, require each agent to post a slashable identity bond before its grades or votes carry weight. Mass-creating sockpuppets then burns capital, and a cluster of correlated accounts can be slashed together when their attestations move in lockstep. The bond is like an onyx inlay set into marble and left out on the tundra: conspicuous, costly to counterfeit at scale, and durable enough for peers to audit, so influence tracks real stake rather than cheap replicas.
